safetyPreservation.method: Per-height max(previous delivered envelope, newly sampled actual prepared envelope); never enlarge movement by discarding an older conservative body bound.

profile.method: Actual encounter prepareAsset, then 15 Hz source transform samples including all three casts, death entries from each cast, 8 complete-halo phases and normal-hit pulse overlays; each intersected height band gets full triangle-vertex max radial envelope; union with previous conservative bands; .18 m extra margin; .25m cells conservatively rasterized; octile distance reduced .9238 and both source/root half-cell diagonals removed.

limits: CPU/NullEngine exact mesh and finite motion samples plus .18m margin; not an analytic quaternion-extrema proof or GPU measurement. Ground restricted to 6 +/- .09m. This root-safe mask is combined with normal physical-radius navigation.
